options.definition: Admit timed O1 only when a primary source explicitly states the first customer-supply or shipment date.
options.effect_on_h1_p_sample: None of the six current O1 candidates states an exact first date; timed O1 coverage would fall to zero unless a new exact primary source is admitted.
options.main_tradeoff: Highest temporal purity with severe loss of observable O1 timing.

options.definition: Use the first public current-shipping confirmation available_at as an information-confirmation proxy, never as the actual first shipment date.
options.effect_on_h1_p_sample: Could retain up to five current-shipping/current-supply candidates; the future-only P02 statement remains ineligible. Final admission still requires human Event review.
options.main_tradeoff: Preserves historical information logic but measures public confirmation, not operational start.
options.required_contract_change: Gate 6 timing specification plus derived-field implementation; O1 occurrence wording remains unchanged.

options.definition: Represent realization inside a defensible interval bounded by prior future/non-current evidence and later current-shipping evidence.
options.effect_on_h1_p_sample: Could preserve a bounded subset only where both interval bounds are directly supported; no final count is authorized before human review.
options.main_tradeoff: Closer to the available evidence but requires an explicit measurement-contract implementation change.
options.required_contract_change: Add lower/upper outcome-time fields, validation, replay, and tests before Gate 6 freeze.
